label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Morikawa's Partner Shuffle
items.text: Kevin Kisner revealed Collin Morikawa has had nine different partners in Presidents and Ryder Cups mainly because Morikawa is not an elite putter, making pairings uncomfortable in putting contests.

items.headline: Lexi Thompson Joins WTGL
items.text: Pregnant Lexi Thompson called joining the inaugural women's TGL a "no-brainer" to help grow the women's game, competing for Motor City Golf Club while balancing a reduced schedule.

items.headline: McIlroy on UAE Safety
items.text: Rory McIlroy said he remains comfortable playing the DP World Tour finale in the UAE if authorities declare it safe, even as contingency plans are considered amid growing safety concerns.
